description: ERC-8283 attestation index schema, paired with the ERC-7730 v3 draft. This is the mutable '-next' draft: it changes frequently and without notice, and consumers MUST NOT rely on its stability — see ERC-8283 'Index file schemas and versioning'.

version.title: Schema version
version.description: Identical to the ERC-7730 descriptor schema version this index is paired with. A consumer MUST treat an index declaring a version it does not implement as invalid.

entries.title: Attestation set entries
entries.description: Maps each attestationSetId to its member map.

additionalProperties.title: Attestation set members
additionalProperties.description: Maps each set member's attestationFormatId to the absolute URI of its signed attestation blob.

additionalProperties.title: Attestation blob URI
additionalProperties.description: An absolute URI using the identical scheme that was used to successfully fetch this index.json itself — see 'Index file schemas and versioning' in ERC-8283. Never a relative path.
